children: The U.K.'s Debt Management Office sold 1.25 billion pounds ($1.69 billion) in January 2029-dated gilts at a programmatic tender on Tuesday, it said.
The following are results of the tender, with amounts in pounds. Figures in brackets are data from the previous tender of this bond, held on June 25, 2026.

Issue              0.5% January, 2029 gilt 
Amount on offer    1.25 bln 
Bids received      4.56 bln 
Bids accepted      1.25 bln 
Bid-to-cover ratio 3.65   (3.61) 
Average yield      4.818% (4.062%) 
Average price      90.4   (91.30) 
Maximum yield      4.822% (4.064%) 
Yield Tail         0.4Bps (0.2Bp) 
Settlement date    Sept 16, 2026
